doc: A new activity file holds the binding's template, the header alone (spec 014 research R5). Each list is created at the end of the file with its first entry and removed with its last; a specification's tasks are created after its status, and the switch is inserted after the header. All of it is undone back to the template and one edit redone.

steps.doc: Opening and saving without an edit writes the bytes that were read.
Turning on the switch in a new file inserts showArchived right after the header, the one key bound before it.
The first project creates projects: at the end of the file (insert.create, end-of-document).
steps.expect:
agent-activity-diagram: 1
showArchived: true
projects:
  - id: p-notion
    name: etalii.adp.ide.notion

steps.doc: The first specification creates specifications: at the end of the file; its project is a reference by id.

    status: pending
